name: On New File
description: Checks new .ts/.js files for placement, import style, and dependency rules

then.prompt:
A new file was created. Please verify:
1. The file is in the correct folder per structure.md (e.g. server code in a2a-server/packages/, client code in a2a-client/packages/)
2. All imports use .js extensions (NodeNext moduleResolution requirement)
3. No imports from forbidden cross-package paths (a2a-server must not import from a2a-client and vice versa)
4. If the file is a public export, add it to the nearest index.ts barrel
5. If the file exceeds ~300 lines, suggest splitting it
Report any violations found.
